_about: Public bank and insurance documents found on the internet, used by tools/check_public_docs.py. The PDFs are NOT in git (sample_data/Dossier Public*/ is ignored): run tools/fetch_public_samples.py to download them. Each file is checked against its sha256. They are third-party documents: this list only records where they come from.

files.name: bnc_guide_releve_bai.pdf
files.source: Banque Nationale du Canada: 'Relevé de compte bancaire BAI, Guide de l'utilisateur' (18 pages, Word export). A technical specification with example records.
files.kind: digital, example records in tables, some pictures

files.name: gwu_bank_statement_sample.pdf
files.source: George Washington University admissions: 'Sample Bank Statement' (a Shinhan Bank certificate of deposit with the placeholder sponsor 'Martha Washington').
files.kind: scanned image of a bank form, text labels and a signature in a script font

files.name: dc_declaration_sample.pdf
files.source: District of Columbia Department of Insurance, Securities and Banking: sample homeowners declarations page (fictional insureds John and Susy Doe).
files.kind: digital, one page, English, US address formats

files.name: ok_declarations_sample.pdf
files.source: Oklahoma Insurance Department: 'Understanding your homeowners insurance declarations page' (example named insured John E. Doe).
files.kind: digital explainer with a sample declarations page drawn as text and pictures

files.name: ok_declarations_sample_bridgford.pdf
files.source: Sample homeowners declarations page ('COMPANY ABZ', named insureds John D Sample and Jane A Sample) published on a law firm website. Licence not known.
files.kind: searchable scan: one picture with an invisible OCR text layer, English

files.name: ca_assurance_habitation_fiche.pdf
files.source: Crédit Agricole: product sheet 'Assurance habitation propriétaire intégrale' (Pacifica). No personal data: company identity and general terms only.
files.kind: digital, one page, French, company addresses and phone numbers

files.name: sg_mrh_conditions_generales.pdf
files.source: Société Générale Assurances: general conditions 'Assurance habitation' (64 pages, ref. H 190 315, 06/2026). No personal data.
files.kind: digital, 64 pages of French legal text, a cover photo of two people, scanned pages
